articles.summary: STAMFORD, Conn. , Dec. 03, 2025 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Star Group, L.P. (the “Company” or “Star”) (NYSE: SGU), a leading home energy distributor and services provider, today announced that it will release its fiscal 2025 fourth quarter results after the close of trading on December 8, 2025 .
